improvements.areaName: SEO Meta Description and OG Tags
improvements.suggestion:
<meta name="description" content="Gideon is your Claude-powered AI assistant for trade and business. Get instant answers, voice chat, and professional support. Try three free searches, then unlock unlimited access from US$2/day.">
<meta property="og:title" content="GDN AI – Gideon | Your AI Trade & Business Assistant">
<meta property="og:description" content="Claude-powered AI assistant for business owners, traders, and professionals. Instant answers, voice chat, and unlimited workspace access. Start with three free searches.">
<meta property="og:type" content="website">
<meta property="og:site_name" content="GDN AI">
improvements.rationale: A compelling meta description improves click-through rates from search results by clearly stating what Gideon offers and the free trial hook. Open Graph tags ensure professional, consistent previews when the homepage is shared on LinkedIn, Twitter, or Facebook—critical for a B2B audience. The copy highlights key differentiators (Claude-powered, voice chat, trade focus) and the low-barrier entry point without overpromising.

improvements.suggestion:
Hero Headline: "Meet Gideon — Your AI Trade & Business Assistant"

Subheading: "Get instant answers, voice chat support, and a dedicated workspace to run your business smarter. Try three searches free — no card required."
improvements.rationale: The headline immediately introduces Gideon by name and clarifies its purpose (trade and business assistant), building brand recognition. The subheading highlights three key value props (instant answers, voice chat, workspace) while emphasizing the low-friction free trial. 'No card required' removes signup hesitation and drives conversions. Copy stays factual and within known site context.

improvements.suggestion:
Q: What happens after my three free searches?

A: Once you've used your three complimentary searches, you'll be invited to become a Gideon member to continue accessing unlimited AI-powered trade and business support. Membership starts from just US$2 per day, with flexible monthly or annual billing options—annual plans save you 30 percent. Your workspace, voice chat, and professional assistance are all included.
improvements.rationale: This FAQ directly addresses the most critical conversion point—the moment when free users hit the paywall. By clearly explaining what happens next and immediately presenting the value and affordable entry price, it reduces friction and uncertainty, encouraging users to convert rather than abandon.
